title: The Pedder galaxias recovery plan: Management Phase
why_it_matters: Still the most important unresolved source for reconciling founder counts, original translocation criteria, and early recovery targets.
notes: Now the highest-priority missing document after obtaining Hamr 1992 and the later recovery literature.

title: Inland Fisheries Commission annual reports, newsletters, and stocking logs for Lake Pedder
why_it_matters: Needed to verify the exact 1972 trout stocking chronology, whether any additional stockings occurred, and the earliest trout-growth narrative.

title: Curated museum-lot export for Pedder galaxias and climbing galaxias records from TMAG, QVMAG and Museums Victoria
why_it_matters: Needed to turn the museum-screening insight into a specimen-level chronology with dates, counts, and taxonomic certainty.
notes: ALA already shows promising locality and year structure, but not enough curation for direct modeling use.

title: Early Lake Pedder survey reports and unpublished investigation report
why_it_matters: Would tighten the pre-1990 chronology, especially the shift from broad concern to confirmed four-stream persistence.

title: Primary fish time-series or figures underlying the reported 1977 peak in endemic galaxiids
why_it_matters: Would let us replace the current semi-direct 1977 peak signal with a direct Pedder-specific abundance series for calibration.
notes: Lake 2001 gives the littoral-fauna boom clearly, but the Pedder-specific fish series is still one step removed in the current evidence base.
